notes: D-42: the expression catalog covers every emotion in includeSubgroups, drawn as original art on the teardrop face. face-hand faces keep their hand as an overlay. Finished glyphs in face-hat and face-glasses are decomposed into items plus an expression, not used as templates. cat-face and monkey-face repeat the same emotions on other heads and are deferred to later families. Costume heads are deferred. Hearts, emotion symbols, food, flags, and objects are out of scope.
